notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
Resolved an issue where some players could become stuck in a note widget.

 Pressing [Escape] now pauses the game, replacing the [Tab] key functionality.

notes.title: HOT FIX
notes.content: - Numbers to the code are now more visible, even if the player isn't looking directly at them.

notes.title: HOT FIX
notes.content:
- Added 1 NEW jumpscare.

- Place Parentheses around important key information in notes.

- Fixed a bug that allowed player to type inside the text box of notes.

notes.title: Hot Fix
notes.content:
- Fixed Options Menu in Main Menu bugging out and not working.

- Fixed issue where not everything was being localized.

notes.title: Game Changing Update is HERE!
notes.content:
What's in the Update?

- Checkpoint save feature added

- Increased number of scares 

- Multi-language support integrated

- Reduced reading in notes by 50%

- Improved optimization for smoother gameplay

- Enhanced visuals for a more immersive experience

- Upgraded lighting for better atmosphere

- Objective prompts implemented

- Adjusted locations of certain progression items for smoother gameplay flow

- Added an Inverted Mouse option

- Added a V-Sync option

- Reworked the “Bad Ending” for improved narrative

- Player can now "run" when outdoors



### Bug Fixes & Patches :

- Resolved issue where player could get stuck underneath stairs

- Adjusted background opacity to make white lettering in notes easier to read

notes.title: HOLD ON! Major Update Coming Soon—Wishlist Now for the Best Experience
notes.content:
Dear Players,

Before you hit that "Buy" button,  I wanted to share some exciting news! A major update is on the horizon, set to dramatically enhance your gameplay experience. I'm talking about:




 Checkpoint Save Feature: ✔ Need to take a break from soiling your pants? Reach one of two checkpoints and return when you've come back with fresh pants.

 Better Lighting: 🌟 Atmosphere matters, and the new lighting will immerse you like never before.

 Clearer Objectives: ⏳ No need to sit and finish the game in one session, reach a checkpoint and come back to it later.

 Clearer Objectives: 🧭 No more wandering—get to your next goal with ease.

 Better Optimization: 🚀 Smoother gameplay.

 More Scares: 👻 Prepare for an even creepier experience.
 
 Multiple Languages: 🌍 Enjoy the game in your preferred language.

 Less Reading, More Action: 📖✂️ I've cut the reading by 50%—now the story unfolds more naturally.

 Plus, a new trailer and updated screenshots will be added soon to give you a sneak peek at what's coming! 🎥📸


I recommend adding the game to your Wishlist now and waiting for this update to drop in just a few days. This way, you'll dive into the best version of the game from the start.


Thank you for your support, and stay tuned for more updates!

TS Games LLC

notes.title: How to Update Ethel
notes.content: Although the updates are functioning correctly, they are not being applied UNTIL the player logs out of their Steam account and then logs back in. The update will then commence.
